name: browser-use
headline: Swift Development - Automate iOS/macOS App Coding
short_description: Swift Development Skill enables iOS and macOS app development using Claude Code. Operations teams benefit from automated code generation, debugging, and optimization. It connects to Xcode and SwiftUI workflows, accelerating app development and reducing manual coding efforts.
author: hmohamed01

sections.overview:
The Swift Development Skill provides a comprehensive toolkit for building iOS and macOS applications with Claude Code. It includes quick-reference patterns for SwiftUI, navigation, Swift 6 concurrency, and testing frameworks, along with reference documentation covering Swift Package Manager, xcodebuild commands, simulator control, code signing, and CI/CD setup. The skill includes helper scripts for package creation, test execution with coverage, code formatting and linting, and simulator management. It connects Claude directly to Xcode workflows and development practices, enabling faster code generation, debugging support, and deployment guidance.
Generate SwiftUI views and Observable patterns for iOS 17+ applications
Automate Swift package creation with configuration and naming validation
Run and manage simulator instances for testing and debugging
Execute tests with parallel execution and coverage reporting
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/hmohamed01/swift-development`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
